Use the already approved es-ES presentation. Keep móvil and add celular as a regional equivalent. Broader pan-Hispanic vocabulary coverage is not claimed or mechanically rewritten.

Rebuild source evidence and obtain fresh sense selection for corrected content. This correction ledger selects no OMW sense or reviewer decision.
